subject: Spectronaut file format requirements do not match documentation

messages.author: 112d4415b2bc457c
messages.subject: Spectronaut file format requirements do not match documentation
parts:
Hi,
I tried to run MSStats4.4.1 with a DIA export from Spectronaut, but apparently headers are incompatible. In contrast to what is stated in the documentation, MSStats still seems to use a very old export format from Spectronaut as template (e.g. ProteinName is not recognized as column header but ProteinAccessions is required as proper input when I cross-check with the run example provided). There seems to to be the same issue for MSStatsShiny. Could you please check?
Thank you,
Sandra
